definitions.explanation: a conflict or argument between people, often involving friction or discord

examples.japanese: {揉|も}め{事|ごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}けたい→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧。

examples.english: I have a dispute with my neighbor.

examples.japanese: {遺産相続|いさんそうぞく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{揉|も}め{事|ごと}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{兄弟|きょうだい}→兄弟：00964_kyoudai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{疎遠|そえん}→疎遠：08372_soen⟧になった。
examples.english: The siblings became estranged due to an inheritance dispute.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{揉|も}める→揉める：07385_momeru⟧ (to quarrel, to have friction) + {事|ごと} (matter, thing) → a matter of dispute
⟦{揉|も}める→揉める：07385_momeru⟧ - to quarrel, to have trouble

RELATED WORDS:
- {諍|いさか}い (quarrel, dispute)
- ⟦{喧嘩|けんか}→喧嘩：02996_kenka⟧ (fight, quarrel)
- ⟦トラブル→トラブル：07061_toraburu⟧ (trouble)
- ⟦{紛争|ふんそう}→紛争：05758_funsou⟧ (conflict, dispute - more formal/serious)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {揉|も}め{事|ごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧ (to cause trouble)
- {揉|も}め{事|ごと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれる→巻き込む：05753_makikomu⟧ (to get involved in a dispute)
- {揉|も}め{事|ごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{収|おさ}める→収める：02022_osameru⟧ (to settle a dispute)
